findings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V101 renders: the broader, shallower panel pleat eased the front surface, but both side panels and the rear still retain repeated transverse corrugation and waist-to-hem pinching. Surface quality remains visibly below acceptance.
Front, rear, and side views still show lavender hem trim extending beyond shared panel corners and breaking into angular, uneven joins. Adjacent panel trim does not terminate flush.

Crouch and sit views show the skirt folding into and overlapping raised thighs with a stiff, angular profile. These neutral-pose prototypes do not verify avatar fit, cloth calibration, skinning, shape-key response, Unity/VRChat runtime, or package eligibility.

nextAction: V102 must resolve the shared hem-corner endpoints across adjacent panel paths and reduce the remaining side/rear surface corrugation in the actual overskirt geometry or deformation input. Rebuild from the canonical checkpoint, inspect all five views and six poses directly, and keep the candidate rejected until visual quality and the unverified fit, rig/weight, shape-key, UV, runtime, and release gates are evidenced.
